title: MUIF Event
description: An Event: an immutable record of how semantic reality evolves (see 04-core-concepts/Event.md).

subject.description: Identifier of the affected Object, Relationship, Projection or Contract.

occurrenceTime.description: When the change happened in reality. SEMANTIC.

assertionTime.description: When the change was recorded. NON-SEMANTIC: excluded from the fingerprint.

causality.description: Identifiers of the Events or facts that caused this Event (treated as a set).
